diagnosis.summary: The `nightly` run for 2026-10-01 (run 1fb07270) failed at quality_checks. The row_count_trend checks for orders, order_items and payments each came in at about 50% of their normal volume. The cause is upstream: the day's export left out every web-channel order (0 vs 242 the day before), while app and marketplace orders were normal. Since order_items and payments belong to orders, they lost their web rows too. I've proposed asking upstream to re-export orders, order_items and payments for 2026-10-01, then rerunning.

root_cause.explanation: Upstream's 2026-10-01 export has no web-channel orders. Orders has 235 rows vs 461 the day before (0 web vs 242). The files are well-formed and cover all 24 hours, so this isn't a cut-off file. Order_items and payments dropped by the same ~50% because the items and payments for the web orders are missing too. No dbt model or ingest config changed. Ingest and dbt both succeeded, and only the row-count trend checks caught the gap.

evidence.claim: The run failed at quality_checks. row_count_trend failed for raw.orders, raw.order_items and raw.payments at about 50% of the trailing median.
Ingest and dbt build succeeded, and all dbt tests passed.
No dbt model or ingest config changed.
The web channel is entirely missing (0 vs 242), while app and marketplace counts are normal.
The file is not truncated: all 24 hours are present, the file is well-formed, and the drop is spread evenly across the day.
The runbook says a missing category means a filtered export, and the remedy is to redeliver all related tables for the day.

alternatives_considered: Partial or truncated export: ruled out, because all 24 hours are present and the file is well-formed
A real drop in business: ruled out, because the whole web channel is at zero while the other channels are normal
A bad model deploy: ruled out, because no models changed
rerun_only: wouldn't help, because the landing data itself is missing rows
The web channel being retired on purpose: possible but unlikely for a one-day change with nothing announced. If the redelivery still has no web orders, escalate to upstream_app_team

proposal.rationale: The 2026-10-01 export is filtered, not truncated. Every web-channel order is missing (0 vs 242 on 09-30), while app and marketplace look normal and all 24 hours are present. Order_items and payments dropped by the same ~50% because they belong to the missing web orders. No model or config changed, and ingest and dbt succeeded. The runbook remedy for a one-off filtered or partial export is to redeliver all affected related tables for the day together, then rerun.

applied: upstream re-exported orders (440 rows), order_items (840 rows), payments (417 rows) for 2026-10-01
